items.title: File Widerspruch against refusal of curfew exception
items.quote: Er muss innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift beim Bezirksamt Beispielbek, Marktplatz am Bach 1, 22081 Hamburg erhoben werden.
items.computation: Letter is dated 19.11.2026 (Thursday) and, per the letter's own delivery-fiction clause, is deemed delivered 'am vierten Tag nach der Aufgabe zur Post' (§41 Abs. 2 HmbVwVfG). Assuming posting on the document date, day 1 = 20.11., day 2 = 21.11., day 3 = 22.11., day 4 = 23.11.2026 (Monday) -> deemed Bekanntgabe = 23.11.2026. The one-month Widerspruch period runs under §§187 Abs.1, 188 Abs.2 BGB: the day of the triggering event (23.11.) is not counted (§187 Abs.1), and the one-month period ends on the day in the following month bearing the same number as the triggering day, i.e. 23.12.2026. 23.12.2026 is a Wednesday and not a public holiday in Hamburg, so no shift under §193 BGB is needed.

warnings: The letter states the postal delivery fiction as 'am vierten Tag nach der Aufgabe zur Post' (fourth day after posting); the standard statutory wording in §41 Abs. 2 VwVfG (and its usual Hamburg counterpart) normally reads 'am dritten Tage' (third day). This is unusual and should be double-checked against the actual HmbVwVfG text or by confirming the real postmark/receipt date, since it affects the exact deadline by one day.

No actual date of posting is given in the letter, only the document date (19.11.2026); the deemed-delivery calculation above assumes posting occurred on that same day, which is the standard but unverified assumption.
